metadata.article_title: Health and safety of arrested person

article.title: Health and safety of arrested person
article.content:
56Health and safety of arrested person



Section 56 · Chapter V


It shall be the duty of the person having the custody of an accused to take reasonable care of the
                health and safety of the accused.
